data.title: 艾莉莎 · 给迷迭香留个位置
data.description: 温室台边排了三盆几乎一样的幼苗。艾莉莎把写好的木签插进最矮的花盆，指背蹭到一点泥。她将花盆往旁边移开，给后面那盆让出一格日照。
data.action: 把木签插到小花盆里，再移动花盆
data.lighting: 玻璃顶的漫射光照亮叶尖和冰蓝开衫
data.camera: 齐腰中景，花盆和手同框
data.mood: 专心、整理完后松了口气
data.promptProse: Alya pushes a wooden marker into a small herb pot on the greenhouse bench, then slides the pot aside to give the next seedling a square of light. The cropped ice-blue cardigan falls open above her white square-neck dress as she leans over the row.
data.animaCaption: Her muddy knuckle brushes the rim as the wooden marker goes into the soil.
